entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can help conceal your allies.

Prerequisite(s): Stealth 1 rank.

Benefit(s): Whenever you are adjacent to an ally, and neither you nor that ally move for at least 1 round, and both you and that ally attempt Stealth checks, that ally can use your Stealth check result if it is better than his own.
